audience: customer support agents and team leads who work cases in Kayako

useCases.title: List open cases and who is assigned to them
useCases.text: The AI lists cases filtered by status type, tags, priority level or requester, so you see what is open. It can expand the assignee and team of each case.

useCases.title: Read a case timeline and summarize it
useCases.text: The AI opens a case and reads its posts, with customer messages, agent replies and internal notes, and tells you what happened so far.

useCases.title: Find all cases of a customer organization
useCases.text: The AI searches for an organization and lists the cases raised by its members, so you see how many there are and what they are about.

useCases.title: Find help-center articles for an answer
useCases.text: The AI searches the help center and opens articles with their localized title, content, section and tags, so you can answer a customer from them.

useCases.title: Create a customer user, or create or update a case
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer user, opens a case for a requester, or changes a case's status, priority, assignee, tags or custom fields.

useCases.title: Add an internal note or reply, and set status
useCases.text: The AI adds an internal note that only agents see, or sends a public reply on a channel such as MAIL, and can set status, priority or assignee in the same step.
